description: The cost of training frontier AI models has increased significantly, with recent models costing over $100 million to train.

instances.assertion: The cost of training frontier AI models has increased significantly, with recent models costing over $100 million to train.
The cost of training large AI models is significantly higher than just the rental cost of GPUs, as it must include the total cost of ownership for building and maintaining massive compute clusters.
Training costs for frontier AI models have reached over USD 100 million for models like ChatGPT 4 and Gemini 1.0 Ultra.
Training costs for frontier AI models like ChatGPT 4 and Gemini 1.0 Ultra exceed $100 million.
